description: RFA reports a gathering of around 100 workers outside a private employer’s home to demand unpaid wages on February 22. It separately reports earlier written complaints to district/provincial labor authorities and the Ministry of Labor and Social Welfare. The available account does not say whether workers directed a demand to the Lao state during the gathering, so the private-dispute exclusion remains provisional.
required_followup: Review the complete permitted reporting and any independent contemporary sources for the demand and intended addressee at the February 22 gathering. Keep earlier agency complaints separate from actions at the home.

description: Turnout is reported as “around 100” by two RFA articles in the same reporting chain. The exact number, method, and independent corroboration are unknown. Do not use the workforce, number of unpaid employees, or paid employees as crowd estimates.
required_followup: Seek independent contemporaneous reporting or original documentation. Preserve the approximate original estimate and do not create numeric bounds without explicit evidence.

description: The reported gathering is placed outside the owner’s home in Nam Bak district, Luang Prabang province, but its exact address, organizer, participant composition, duration, and physical end are not given in the saved prior-unit summaries.
required_followup: If permitted body review or independent sources become available, record only exact site, organization, and event-end evidence they support; do not equate later mediation or payment with physical end.

description: Search results identify an RFA report on Namtha 1 Dam resettlement and a BHR Centre result that reproduces the same report. Their headers establish a land/livelihood lead, not a February public gathering or protest. Four exact-URL receipts and manual reviews were completed, but each immediate full-input recheck found concurrent source-ledger hash changes; no body request was made and no source denial was observed.
required_followup: For any later source request, use the ordinary individually gated process: a fresh exact-URL receipt, complete manual publisher/origin review, and an immediate full-input recheck. Then determine whether either page documents a public assembly and any event date, turnout, demand, or state target. Treat the two pages as one RFA-origin reporting chain if confirmed.

description: The RFA candidate-removal article S005 remains search-only. The full CIVICUS retrospective S006 discusses the 21 February election but does not describe a public gathering in Laos during February; it recounts a 2016 Lao activists’ demonstration outside the embassy in Thailand, Hmong attacks and a March access decree, and a February UN communication about Sombath Somphone. Headers and this retrospective do not establish another eligible event.
required_followup: If contemporary February event reporting is found, verify its exact chronology, location, assembly, attendance, demand and state target through fresh individually gated body review. Review S005 only if it could document an assembly; do not treat arrests, attacks or the election itself as protest events.

description: The prior RFA account places requests for wages in December and January before the February 22 gathering. Those requests are not reported as public gatherings. The May follow-up reports April mediation and wage payment but does not establish that the February action physically continued until then.
required_followup: Seek dated evidence of any public action before or after February 22 and its physical ending. Do not convert requests, filings, later mediation, or payment into event continuity.

description: The 45 captured open-web search actions produced 819 ordered headers across English, Lao, Thai, Chinese, and Vietnamese queries, including date windows for all four February weeks. This does not reproduce LexisNexis or systematic Lao newspaper archives; language, indexing, censorship, and access limits remain.
required_followup: Use any available systematic local newspaper and archive search in a later review. Do not infer that no other events occurred from the present search results.

description: The official Mass Mobilization baseline/version and applicable original Coding Procedure remain pending. This dossier uses the documented provisional instructions only and cannot establish official coding or integration.
required_followup: Coordinator should resolve the official baseline and missing procedure before any official inclusion or integration decision.

description: An unopened RFA search-result excerpt about Nam Ngum 4 says compensation was inadequate and refers to a woman who promised not to protest after her family accepted compensation, plus a man from the same village reportedly held until February 2021. A FIDH UPR search result also refers to June 2021 Nam Ngum 4 displacement reporting. These snippets do not establish a public assembly, its date, size, or demand in February; detention is not an assembly.
required_followup: If these bodies are accessed under fresh exact-URL gates, clarify whether any distinct public assembly occurred and its date, crowd, state-directed demand, and physical endpoint. Keep detention and individual compensation disputes separate; do not infer a February gathering or continuation.
